```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(numbers)
# (a+bi)/(c+di)

# (a+bi)(c-di)/(c^2+d^2)
# ((ac+bd)+(bc-ad)i)/(c^2+d^2)
gcd2 <- function(a, b) {
  if (b == 0) a else Recall(b, a %% b)
}
gcd <- function(...) Reduce(gcd2, c(...))

while(T){
    abcd = sample(c(2:9),4)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    gg1 = gcd(abs(abcd))
    a = abcd[1]/gg1
    b = abcd[2]/gg1
    c = abs(abcd[3]/gg1)
    d = abcd[4]/gg1
    
    e1 = paste0("\\frac{",a,"+",b,"i}{",c,"+",d,"i}")
    e1 = gsub("+-","-",e1,fixed=T)
    
    # (r+qi)/n
    
    r = a*c+b*d
    q = b*c-a*d
    n = c^2+d^2
    gg2 = gcd(abs(c(r,q,n)))
    r2 = r/gg2
    q2 = q/gg2
    n2 = n/gg2
    
    e2 = paste0("\\frac{",r2,"+",q2,"i}{",n2,"}")
    e2 = gsub("+-","-",e2,fixed=T)
    if(min(abs(c(r2,q2,n2)))>1 && max(abs(c(r,q,n)))<70){break}
}


e3 = paste0("\\frac{(",a,"+",b,"i)(",c,"+",-d,"i)}{(",c,"+",d,"i)(",c,"+",-d,"i)}")
e3 = gsub("+-","-",e3,fixed=T)


e4 = paste0("\\frac{",a*c,"+",-a*d,"i+",b*c,"i+",-b*d,"i^2}{",c^2,"+",-c*d,"i+",c*d,"i+",-d^2,"i^2}")
e4 = gsub("+-","-",e4,fixed=T)

e5 = paste0("\\frac{",a*c,"+",-a*d,"i+",b*c,"i+",b*d,"}{",c^2,"+",-c*d,"i+",c*d,"i+",d^2,"}")
e5 = gsub("+-","-",e5,fixed=T)

e6 = paste0("\\frac{",a*c+b*d,"+",-a*d+b*c,"i}{",c^2+d^2,"}")
e6 = gsub("+-","-",e6,fixed=T)

ans = paste0("(",r2,"+",q2,"i)/",n2)
ans = gsub("+-","-",ans,fixed=T)
```

Question
========

Simplify the following expression so that the denominator is a positive real integer.

$$`r e1`$$

Your answer will have the form $\frac{r+qi}{n}$.

*If your answer is $\frac{4-10i}{3}$, type your answer as `(4-10i)/3` without any spaces.*

Solution
========

Multiply the numerator and denominator by the complex conjugate of the denominator.

$$`r e3`$$

"FOIL" the numerator and "FOIL" the denominator.

$$`r e4`$$

Remember, $i^2=-1$.

$$`r e5`$$

Combine like terms.

$$`r e6`$$

If all terms have a common factor, reduce the fraction. The greatest common factor of `r abs(a*c+b*d)` and `r abs(-a*d+b*c)` and `r abs(c^2+d^2)` is the number `r gg2`.

$$`r e2`$$

So, your answer is typed exactly like ``r ans`` without any spaces.
